title: A body mass index calculator
description:
Calculate a body mass index (BMI) and say which range it is in.

```
Weight in kg: 72
Height in cm: 180
BMI: 22.2 (healthy)
```

starter.main.py:
weight = float(input("Weight in kg: "))
height_cm = float(input("Height in cm: "))

# TODO: check the input, work out the BMI and its range, print the result

hints: Convert centimetres to metres first (`height_cm / 100`), then square it with `** 2`.
Keep the range in a variable set by one `if` / `elif` chain, so the `print` happens only once at the end.
requirements: BMI is the weight in kilograms divided by the height in metres squared.
Print it with one decimal and the range: below 18.5 `underweight`, below 25 `healthy`, below 30 `overweight`, otherwise `obese`.
If the weight or height is 0 or less, print `Weight and height must be positive`.
stretch: Also print the weight range that would count as healthy for that height (BMI 18.5 to 24.9).
